title: Hours Well Spent
tagline: Shared-time vignettes: NPC-proposed, LLM-written, remembered by everyone there, and good for a skill.
description:
NPCs propose spending time together: going over the ledgers, sparring in the yard, a long night over wine. Confirm, and the hours pass behind a fade; SkyrimNet writes how they went from who you both are, where you are and what the NPC remembers. It's narrated, so everyone present remembers it, and you practise a fitting skill.

**Requires:** HoursWellSpent.esp (shipped with this mod), PapyrusUtil, powerofthree's Papyrus Extender.
author: whyregister
